summary.text: Dragonman Extermination is Duke Long's immortal killer move. As dragonman ancestor he can use it to wipe out the dragonman race.

claims.text: In a memory of persuading Red Lotus Demon Venerable, Duke Long activates the immortal killer move Dragonman Extermination. Red Lotus senses its nature and effect and shouts that Duke Long has killed all the dragonmen in the world, including Duke Long’s own children and bloodline descendants who had turned into dragonmen. Duke Long confirms he is the ancestor of dragonmen and the first dragonman, and that when he created the dragonman transformation method he already left this arrangement so he could eliminate other dragonmen through that ancestor identity. Star Constellation’s will had earlier told him to let the dragonmen live for a time and use them later when a dragonmen reign supreme revelation appeared.

On the Infallible blessed land battlefield, Duke Long activates Dragonman Extermination again to kill Bai Ning Bing. Her body shakes, she falls coughing blood, and she dies inside Dragon Palace under Dragon Spirit’s gaze; Dragon Spirit was born only after Duke Long had already exterminated the dragonman race.

During Wu Shuai’s Dream Token refinement journey, after rest on South Flower Island and while he moves through immemorial white heaven, dream revelations prove Duke Long has an immortal killer move that can exterminate the dragonman race, and Wu Shuai learns its name is Dragonman Extermination. As ancestor and source of the race, Duke Long left that hidden card when he created the dragonman race; activating it makes all dragonmen in the world self-detonate and die with none surviving. Dragonmen, the dragonman lifespan extension method, and dragonman extermination are tightly connected through that source. After Dream Token is refined and rank eight Dragon Palace is built, Wu Shuai seeks to reverse-deduce the move by using Dragon Palace for experiments on the dragonman body.

After refining the dragonman clone’s bones, hair, blood, flesh, fingernails, organs, and brain, Fang Yuan makes that body immune to Duke Long’s dragonman extermination. Wu Shuai had come close without fully breaking the move, leaving experimental ideas that later dragonman Gu Immortals tested; Fang Yuan uses those clues to finish the modification. Immunity covers only Duke Long’s dragonman extermination; a version Fang Yuan created himself would still affect the clone, and the clone’s soul still needs separate modification because it had adapted to the original dragonman body.
Heavenly Court Gu Immortals later recall that during the fate war Duke Long secretly used dragonman extermination but could not end Wu Shuai’s life, and that he told them this afterward.
